Where We Come From

## Built for Content Teams.  _Refined for Agencies._

SEOwind started as an AI-powered platform for in-house teams to create SEO-focused, EEAT-compliant articles at scale.

Agencies leaned on that system, so **we refined it into a fully white-labeled production engine.** What powers our platform now powers your agency.

- **Automation** – AI agents handle briefs, drafts, and quality signals

- **Human editorial** – editors step in where it counts

Real people. Experienced team. **No ghosting**. **No BS**.

How It Works – **The Cyborg Method**

## AI + Humans.  _Better Together._

At the core of SEOwind is the CyborgMethod – **a hybrid system** where AI does the heavy lifting, humans add the nuance, and everything is **delivered fully white-label under your brand.**

- **AI for speed** – AI agents handle briefs, drafts, and pre-score quality signals
- **Humans for nuance** – editors step where it counts: tone, and high-context accuracy
- **Grounded in facts** – RAG and research agent pulls from real sources
- **Quality built-in** – automated EEAT scoring + refinements

## Not Just Prompting.  _A Production System._

We do not just prompt AI. We run a structured **AI + human workflow proven to deliver consistent, accurate content at scale.**

## Questions We Hear From Agencies (A Lot)

### [What makes SEOwind different from other AI writing tools?](https://seowind.io/\#)

This is not another tool. It is a production system that plugs into your ops and ships content reliably. We combine AI automation with human editorial oversight.

### [Will my clients know you are involved?](https://seowind.io/\#)

No. Everything is fully white-labeled. We deliver CMS-ready content under your brand with no mention of SEOwind.

### [How do you handle different client voices?](https://seowind.io/\#)

We match client voice through onboarding. You provide examples, brand guidelines, or sample content – we will figure out the rest and run human QA where it matters.
